About the studio

Small studio. Connected thinking.

Design meets technology Built in Tamil Nadu

Code Constellation brings design, engineering and growth together. Founded by Sanjai K in Tamil Nadu, India, we help ambitious teams move from idea to orbit — and we work with them wherever they are.

01

Why we started

Good ideas deserve a connected team.

Brand, technology and growth work best when they work together. Code Constellation was built around that idea: one studio connecting how a business looks, how it works and how it reaches people.

02

Where we are going

One studio. A wider perspective.

From a clear identity to a useful digital product, we look at the whole picture. We bring design thinking and thoughtful engineering to the same table, with a focus on clarity, craft and work that lasts.

How we work

Four studio principles.

  1. 01

    Start with the right question.

    We begin with your goals, your audience and the problem worth solving. A clearer question gives every design and engineering decision a purpose.

  2. 02

    Give good ideas room.

    We explore, test and refine. Making space for thoughtful work helps us find a direction with character and substance.

  3. 03

    Make every detail useful.

    A strong identity and a smooth experience should work together. We care about how things look, what they communicate and how they feel to use.

  4. 04

    Keep it clear.

    We simplify the message, the interface and the way we work together. Complexity belongs behind the scenes, not between you and your customers.
